title: devices.json terminal_sessions
description: The terminal sessions of the person (table terminal_sessions): who worked when from which device on which host with which profile, bytes per direction and the reason for the end. Never contents.

device_id.description: ID of the device of the last opening or attaching.

profile.description: Name of the profile of the host.

started_at.description: When the host started the session.

bytes_in.description: Bytes sent from the device to the host.

bytes_out.description: Bytes sent from the host to the device.
